timing.warm: One untimed full solve per persistent worker; wall time inside the worker from compute selection and input construction through native route selection, certification, complete reduced basis text, freeing its handle and collecting the execution report.
timing.fresh: Fresh interpreter from parent process launch to receipt of the full basis via stdout and process exit. Filesystem and device compiler caches may be warm.
timing.phase_ms: Separate diagnostic runs call atlas_groebner_modular directly; the native phase times do not include work performed before the default route switches to modular.
timing.order: Each round rotates the starting case; each complete rotation reverses direction. Solves run one at a time. OS activity is uncontrolled.
